scope: Repository-local JSON shape and credential length validation for POST /auth/login

criteria.description: The route accepts only a JSON object and never dereferences null, arrays or primitives as a LoginRequest.
Username and password are non-empty strings at most 128 characters; optional accountId is a non-empty string at most 255 characters.
criteria.limitations: The selected boundary does not change account UUID or email-login policy.

criteria.description: Invalid payloads return the existing sanitized 400 envelope without invoking AuthService.login or creating a session; rate limiting remains first.
criteria.limitations: The existing distributed rate-limit backend is outside this slice.

criteria.description: Successful login, cookies, refresh/session behavior, MFA and WebAuthn route behavior remain regression-compatible.
criteria.limitations: No browser authenticator or production identity-provider certification is inferred.

criteria.description: Affected API/auth regressions, build/typecheck, static checks and security checks pass within the bounded worktree.
criteria.limitations: Full workspace lint retains two unrelated pre-existing counterSales errors.

criteria.description: A fresh independent read-only review reports no remaining Critical, High or Medium finding against this bounded contract.
criteria.limitations: Approval is only for the login input boundary, not the ERP or production state.

gaps: No external provider, target, production, deployment, remote CI, release or global ERP readiness claim is made.
The unrelated full-workspace counterSales lint baseline remains open.
conditions: Keep validation after IP/identity rate limiting and before AuthService.login.
Do not expand this child gate into email login, account UUID policy, password hashing, MFA/session policy or external operations without revalidation.
Preserve global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion BLOCKED.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via fresh residual scouting and implementation-ready gate
authority.decision: Close only the repository-local object/type/length validation slice after TDD, regression, security and independent review evidence.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing login identity semantics, hashing/MFA/session policy, rate-limit backend/order, account ID format or any target/production behavior.

next_action: Return to fresh residual scouting after committing this bounded slice; keep global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion BLOCKED.
